item.title: Power Grid Crisis, Political Blame, Maritime Graduation
item.ns0:title: Power Grid Crisis, Political Blame, Maritime Graduation
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the nation’s power grid is pushed to its breaking point as officials warn of potential holiday weekend blackouts amidst record-breaking summer heat. The political firestorm intensifies as the opposition slams the government's handling of the energy crisis, while a grieving community gathers for a somber memorial to honor the victims of the tragic Flamingo Air crash. We also bring you details on a major multi-million dollar drug bust and celebrate a golden performance by a Bahamian track star on the international stage. Join us for these headlines and your full weekend weather forecast to see if relief from the blistering temperatures is on the way.
-----
